risks.risk: Some keys may be dead or intermittent (common issue not visible in still photos).
risks.proof: Short video showing a full key sweep (left-to-right) with the display responding, plus a test of the highest and lowest keys.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully confirmed (worst case: possible dead keys).

risks.risk: Buttons/controls may not respond correctly (still photos can’t confirm).
risks.proof: Video pressing each main button/slider/setting and showing the change on the screen/sound output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controls not fully verified.

risks.risk: Audio crackle/noise may occur at certain volumes or when using speakers/headphones.
risks.proof: Record a 10–20 second audio clip playing a few notes/chords at low and high volume (and ideally with headphones if available).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if crackle could exist (worst case: not guaranteed clean sound).

risks.risk: Adapter/power supply may be missing or incompatible (seller says included, but not clearly shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter label/model and a shot showing it plugged into the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as adapter not guaranteed included.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is unknown; price depends heavily on model/features.
risks.proof: Photo of the model number label/sticker (usually on the back/bottom) and the full front panel name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest likely Yamaha keyboard tier based on appearance (worst case for value).

proof_requests: Photo of the keyboard’s model number label (back or bottom) so the exact Yamaha model can be priced correctly.
Video test: play every key (full range) and show the display responding.
Video test: press all buttons/controls and show changes on screen/sound.
Audio recording: short clip at low and high volume to confirm no crackle.
Photo of the adapter/power supply label and a shot of it connected to the keyboard.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Yamaha electronic keyboard, but the exact model and full working condition (all keys/buttons, no crackle, adapter included) are not provable from still images. Request the model label and functional test clips before pricing.
